promptEs: En Re mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/V?
promptEn: In D major, which degree does V/V resolve to?
explanationEs: En Re mayor, V/V es Mi7 y resuelve en La (V). Su tercera es la sensible de La y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In D major, V/V is E7 and it resolves to A (V). Its third is the leading tone of A and rises a semitone when it resolves.
